alt_text: In a holiday market of glass kiosks and string lights, a street caricaturist in a red beanie and mustard jacket frowns at his easel while a woman whose skin and hair are polished grey-ivory marble sits upright on a folding stool facing him, wearing a butter-yellow top, a tobacco suede jacket over her shoulders, a brown skirt and cognac boots.
